title: A photothermal energy storage phase change material with high stability and enthalpy

In this study, CNT-BN-SA-1 composites were prepared by vacuum impregnation using stearic acid (SA) as a phase change material (PCM), multi-walled carbon nanotubes (CNT) and hexagonal boron nitride (BN) as support materials.
